queries: WITH c AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM c) AS diff_from_avg_of_avgs FROM c ORDER BY death_country;

WITH c AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - (SELECT AVG(avg_points) FROM c) AS diff_from_avg_of_avgs FROM c ORDER BY death_country;

WITH c AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points FROM player_award_vote v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND v.points_won IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points, avg_points - AVG(avg_points) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_of_avgs FROM c ORDER BY death_country;

assumptions.assumption: 'Players who received award votes' means rows in player_award_vote (not manager_award_vote), joined to player by player_id.
Players with no death_country (mostly living players) are excluded, since they have no death country to show.

'How far' is the signed difference (country average minus the simple mean of the per-country averages), unrounded. Countries whose points_won are all null have a null average and are left out of the mean of averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Keep players with a null death_country as their own group (a NULL row) and count it in the mean of averages.

assumptions.assumption: Award votes means rows in player_award_vote. manager_award_vote is not used, because it has no foreign key to player.
The average is over all vote rows in each country, not first averaged per player. Players with a NULL death_country (mostly living players) are excluded, since they have no death country to group by.
'How far from' is the signed difference (country average minus the unweighted mean of the country averages). The mean of averages is not weighted by the number of votes.

alternatives.interpretation: 'How far' read as an absolute distance, with no sign.

assumptions.assumption: 'Award votes' means rows in player_award_vote, which is the table linked to player. manager_award_vote is not used.
Each country's average is taken over vote rows, not per player. A player with several vote rows counts once per row.
Players with a NULL death_country (mostly living players) are left out. They have no death country to show.
Countries whose points_won values are all NULL have a NULL average. The overall simple average ignores them.
